text:
maria (sales): Hey team — AtlasCorp wants to run a 30-day POC next week. They need: SOC 2 interim attestation or scoped controls letter, an NDA that allows our engs to see limited customer data (redacted), and temporary read access to S3 logs for troubleshooting. Also asking rough Dedicated pricing for a small POC (predictable latency). Can we support this? cc @ajay @liam @sophie

ajay (solutions): We can do the POC on a tiny Dedicated pool. Need to confirm target qps/seq len. For S3 access we usually do time-limited presigned URLs + a narrow prefix. Do they need streaming logs or aggregated batches?

liam (security): SOC2 interim attestation = we can provide an "interim attestation letter" summarizing controls in-scope and pointing to the latest SOC 2 report. Not a full report extract but acceptable for most vendors. We can also produce a short controls summary (encryption, access mgmt, incident response).

sophie (legal): For the NDA: we should avoid broad data-license grants. We can add an Engineer Access Addendum with: 1) purpose-limited access, 2) auto-redaction requirement, 3) TTL on access (<=30 days). I'll draft and share a one-page addendum. Any required 3rd-party hosting clauses from Atlas?

maria (sales): They asked specifically for VPC endpoints and S3 prefix "atlascorp/poc-logs/" and said they don't want full bucket listing. Also asked if we can sign a minimal Acknowledgement of SOC2 interim.

ajay (solutions): For Dedicated sizing — if they want ~20 rps with 512 token seq we can propose: 1 x A10G (or equivalent) reserved for POC with autoscale to 2 under burst. Week-by-week price: use short-term trial rate: 
```
– Reserved: $6k/week
– Burst buffer (on-demand GPU): $800/day
```
This is ballpark, finance will finalize.

liam (security): S3 access pattern: we can grant presigned URLs scoped to `atlascorp/poc-logs/*` and rotate keys every 12 hours. Sample policy I can push: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
    "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-poc-bucket/atlascorp/poc-logs/*"]
  }]
}
```
Make sure Atlas signs the addendum saying they accept redaction practice.

sophie (legal): I'll attach NDA + Engineer Addendum draft by EOD. We should also include a small clause allowing us to provide the interim attestation copy to Atlas's infosec team.

maria (sales): Timeline: POC kickoff Mon 3/29, need NDA signed by 3/26, attestation copy by 3/27, S3 access ready 3/29. Can we hit that?

liam (security): Tight but doable. I'll prepare the attestation letter template and upload. security-bot will post when it's live.

security-bot: uploaded interim-attestation-atlascorp-2026-03-27.pdf to /shared/security/attestations (link restricted) :lock: 

ajay (solutions): I'll prepare the POC runbook + minimal infra config and a troubleshooting checklist. Will sync with Maria for access list.

maria (sales): Thanks — next actions: Sophie to send NDA + addendum, Liam to upload attestation and S3 policy, Ajay to send POC config and provisional pricing. I'll loop in Atlas legal once NDA draft is ready. :thumbsup:
